subs.label: Snap share %
subs.tip: Share of his team offensive snaps he was on the field for. Snaps / team snaps.

subs.label: Snaps / game
subs.tip: Offensive snaps divided by games played.

subs.label: Touches / game
subs.tip: Carries plus targets, divided by games played.

subs.label: Carries / game
subs.tip: Rushing attempts divided by games played.

subs.label: Targets / game
subs.tip: Times he was thrown at, divided by games played.

subs.label: Receptions / game
subs.tip: Catches divided by games played.

subs.label: Pass attempts / game
subs.tip: Pass attempts divided by games played - the quarterback version of volume.

subs.label: Yards per touch
subs.tip: Yards from scrimmage divided by carries plus catches.

subs.label: Yards per carry
subs.tip: Rushing yards divided by carries.

subs.label: Yards per target
subs.tip: Receiving yards divided by targets - rewards catching AND catching deep.

subs.label: Yards per reception
subs.tip: Receiving yards divided by catches.

subs.label: Catch rate %
subs.tip: Catches divided by targets.

subs.label: Drop rate %
subs.tip: Drops divided by targets. Lower is better.

subs.label: Broken tackles / carry
subs.tip: Broken tackles divided by carries.

subs.label: Yards after contact / carry
subs.tip: Yards after contact divided by carries.

subs.label: Air yards per target
subs.tip: Air yards divided by targets - how far downfield he is used.

subs.label: Runs stuffed / carry
subs.tip: Runs stopped at or behind the line, divided by carries. Lower is better.

subs.label: Yards per pass attempt
subs.tip: Passing yards per attempt.

subs.label: Completion %
subs.tip: Completion percentage.

subs.label: Passer rating
subs.tip: Traditional passer rating.

subs.label: Sacks taken / dropback
subs.tip: Sacks taken per dropback. Lower is better.

subs.label: Red-zone carries / game
subs.tip: Carries inside the opponent 20, divided by games.

subs.label: Red-zone targets / game
subs.tip: Targets inside the opponent 20, divided by games.

subs.label: TDs per red-zone touch
subs.tip: Touchdowns divided by red-zone touches - does he finish once he gets there.

subs.label: Touchdowns / game
subs.tip: Total touchdowns divided by games played.

subs.label: Pass attempts in the red zone / game
subs.tip: Pass attempts inside the opponent 20, per game.

subs.label: Passing touchdowns / game
subs.tip: Passing touchdowns divided by games played.

subs.label: First touchdown of a game
subs.tip: Times he scored the first touchdown of a game.

subs.label: 40+ yard plays / game
subs.tip: Plays of 40+ yards, run or catch, divided by games.

subs.label: Long touchdowns / game
subs.tip: Touchdowns of 40+ yards divided by games.

subs.label: 20+ yard catches / game
subs.tip: Catches of 20-39 yards divided by games.

subs.label: Passing touchdowns of 40+ yards
subs.tip: Passing touchdowns of 40 yards or more.

subs.label: 100-yard games
subs.tip: Games with 100+ yards from scrimmage.

subs.label: Fantasy points / game
subs.tip: PPR fantasy points divided by games played.

subs.label: Total fantasy points
subs.tip: Total PPR fantasy points across the season.

subs.label: Yards / game
subs.tip: Yards from scrimmage (plus 40% of passing yards) divided by games.

subs.label: Total touchdowns
subs.tip: Total touchdowns.

subs.label: Finish at his position
subs.tip: Where he finished at his position in 2025. Lower is better.

components.label: Role
components.desc: His place in the offence this year

subs.label: Share of team touches (2026)
subs.tip: Share of his team's 2026 projected touches at his position.

subs.label: Games started %
subs.tip: Games started divided by games played.

subs.label: Projected touches
subs.tip: Projected 2026 carries plus catches.

subs.label: Games played
subs.tip: Games played in 2025.

subs.label: Games started
subs.tip: Games started in 2025.

subs.label: Interceptions thrown / game
subs.tip: Interceptions thrown per game. Lower is better.

subs.label: Fumbles / game
subs.tip: Fumbles divided by games played. Lower is better.

subs.label: Penalties / game
subs.tip: Penalties divided by games played. Lower is better.

components.label: Upside
components.desc: What could make him leap - nothing here is measured elsewhere

subs.label: Young enough to leap
subs.tip: Years in the league, inverted - younger players have more room to improve.

subs.label: Projected jump on last year
subs.tip: How much more the 2026 projection expects per game than he managed in 2025.

subs.label: Team offence
subs.tip: His offence's projected fantasy points.

subs.label: Team defence
subs.tip: His defence's quality - a good defence means more of the game with the lead.

subs.label: Schedule (easier is better)
subs.tip: Strength of schedule from opponent defences. Easier is better.

components.label: 2026 projection
components.desc: What the projections expect this year
